meta.bt_team: Team rows tested on every game 2019-20 to 2026-27, each judged only on games before it: teams 8-2+ ATS in their last 10 went 532-509 (-6.4%); 15-5+ in their last 20 286-230 (+2.6%); 70%+ in today's role 884-614 (-3.2%); 2-8 or worse 495-507 (-0.4%) the next game at closing prices. Team ATS streaks are noise against the closing line.
meta.bt: Tested out of sample (2021-22 to 2026-27, each season judged only on trends from the seasons before it): every side with a spot covering 5+ points above what its closing price implied (55%+ at -110) on 50+ games went 1,059-942 (52.9%, -3.2% return) against the closing line; 8+ points (58%+) on 100+ games, 200-179 (52.8%, -4.4% return); the first line alone, 271-279 (49.3%, -9.2% return). Totals the same way: 304-327 (48.2%, -7.4% return). Graded at each game's closing price: these trends have not beaten the closing line on games they never saw. Context, not a pick.
meta.bt_short: League row out of sample (2021-22 to 2026-27, each season judged on the two seasons before it): sides whose spot ran 55%+ (5+ points over the price) on 50+ games went 271-279 (49.3%, -9.2% return), lost against the closing line.
meta.bt_held: Of 28 spots the rule bet, 1 made money at closing prices in 3+ later seasons with p < .05, none of them after correcting for how many spots were tried.
